video_goal: Demonstrate the step-by-step application of a sharp, precise winged eyeliner using the Stila Stay All Day Waterproof Liquid Eyeliner.
single_prompt: An extreme close-up focuses on a hand holding the black tube of Stila Stay All Day Waterproof Liquid Eyeliner, rotating it slightly to catch the light on the gold brand lettering. The hand pulls the cap off the tube, exposing the sharp, ink-saturated black felt tip. A bare eye looks slightly downward, with the Stila felt tip hovering just millimeters from the outer corner of the lash line. The felt tip presses against the skin and draws a thin, 45-degree diagonal line extending upward toward the tail of the eyebrow. The pen lifts off the skin and the tip is repositioned to the midpoint of the newly drawn diagonal line. The pen draws a straight line from the midpoint of the tail down to the center of the upper lash line, forming an empty triangle shape. The felt tip colors inside the empty triangle using short, overlapping strokes until the space is completely filled with opaque black ink. The pen moves to the inner corner of the eye, angling the side of the felt tip so it lays flat against the root of the lashes. The pen glides smoothly along the upper lash line from the inner corner, depositing a thin black line that connects seamlessly to the filled-in wing. The very tip of the pen lightly drags outward at the extreme end of the wing, pulling the ink to create a razor-sharp point. The eye blinks slowly, showcasing the matte black finish, smooth lash line connection, and precise shape of the completed winged eyeliner. Finally, the person's face looks directly into the lens, holding the capped Stila eyeliner pen next to their cheek to display the final symmetrical makeup look.
